subject.title: WebChat TTS: add explicit routing/playback logs and user-visible delivery status

question: Should WebChat TTS get a new correlated route/delivery telemetry and UI status contract now, and where should that final status live?
rationale: The missing behavior is not a narrow broken-code fix; it defines event names, correlation scope, and UI ownership across TTS synthesis, Gateway WebChat delivery, and Control UI playback state.

options.title: Define Gateway/WebChat Contract
options.body: Add a small event/status contract around the WebChat delivery projection after the adjacent final-media path is settled, keeping provider-attempt metadata as input rather than inventing a second TTS status source.

options.title: Wait For Delivery PR
options.body: Defer this until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86759 or an equivalent fix lands so the telemetry attaches to the final delivery boundary rather than stale code.

options.title: Decline UI Status For Now
options.body: Keep provider diagnostics and Gateway logs only, avoiding new user-visible WebChat status until maintainers want a broader delivery-state model.

recommendation.title: Define Gateway/WebChat Contract
recommendation.body: Add a small event/status contract around the WebChat delivery projection after the adjacent final-media path is settled, keeping provider-attempt metadata as input rather than inventing a second TTS status source.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh Avant authored the current TTS diagnostics surface, which is the closest existing contract to extend or intentionally keep synthesis-only.
